svg.title: FiiO BTR15 — white interior, matrix-average gray outline, black matrix text, photo-calibrated LED area, two-LED outline stroke
svg.desc: The same clean BTR15 vector outline with a 96x96 matrix reconstruction. The display boundary is intentionally omitted; only matrix cells are drawn.

outline-average.method: direct SVG channel-area average: black LED plus two white edges

matrix-calibration.method: sRGB-linearized baseline-corrected additive luminance over D pitch tiles
